Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write code that submits an audio file for batch transcription using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

Option 2 — AssemblyAI:
  Service: AssemblyAI Transcripts API
  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit

Option 3 — Amazon Transcribe:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 4 — Watson Speech to Text:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

Option 5 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 6 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


def submit_batch_transcription(audio_file_path: str, job_name: str | None = None, bucket_name: str | None = None):
    """
    Submit an audio file for batch transcription using Amazon Transcribe.

    Requirements:
      - AWS credentials configured via environment or IAM role.
      - If bucket_name is not provided, set TRANSCRIBE_INPUT_BUCKET in the environment.
      - The audio file will be uploaded to S3 before starting the transcription job.

    Returns:
      dict with job_name, job_status, transcript_uri, and s3_uri.
    """
    audio_path = Path(audio_file_path)
    if not audio_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Audio file not found: {audio_file_path}")

    region = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or "us-east-1"
    bucket_name = bucket_name or os.environ.get("TRANSCRIBE_INPUT_BUCKET")
    if not bucket_name:
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing S3 bucket name. Pass bucket_name or set TRANSCRIBE_INPUT_BUCKET."
        )

    if not job_name:
        job_name = f"transcribe-{audio_path.stem}-{os.getpid()}"

    s3_client = boto3.client("s3", region_name=region)
    transcribe_client = boto3.client("transcribe", region_name=region)

    s3_key = f"transcribe-inputs/{job_name}/{audio_path.name}"
    s3_uri = f"s3://{bucket_name}/{s3_key}"

    try:
        s3_client.upload_file(str(audio_path), bucket_name, s3_key)
    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to upload audio to S3: {e}") from e

    media_format = audio_path.suffix.lstrip(".").lower()
    if media_format == "mpeg":
        media_format = "mp3"
    allowed_formats = {"mp3", "mp4", "wav", "flac", "ogg", "amr", "webm", "m4a"}
    if media_format not in allowed_formats:
        media_format = "mp3"

    try:
        response = transcribe_client.start_transcription_job(
            TranscriptionJobName=job_name,
            Media={"MediaFileUri": s3_uri},
            MediaFormat=media_format,
            LanguageCode=os.environ.get("TRANSCRIBE_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en-US"),
            OutputBucketName=os.environ.get("TRANSCRIBE_OUTPUT_BUCKET"),
        )
    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to start transcription job: {e}") from e

    job = response.get("TranscriptionJob", {})
    return {
        "job_name": job.get("TranscriptionJobName", job_name),
        "job_status": job.get("TranscriptionJobStatus"),
        "transcript_uri": (job.get("Transcript") or {}).get("TranscriptFileUri"),
        "s3_uri": s3_uri,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        raise SystemExit("Usage: python script.py <audio_file_path> [job_name] [bucket_name]")
    audio_file = sys.argv[1]
    job = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
    bucket = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else None
    result = submit_batch_transcription(audio_file, job_name=job, bucket_name=bucket)
    print(result)
